title: finding(plugin-report,plugin-form): report/spec-report over a dataset and an authored-parent record:line_items read once on mount with no bus reader — blocks objectui#10519 under decision B
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a product defect with named sites. Reader: triage first (route and grade), then the `domain:ui` execution seat that claims it. As a blocker of objectui#10519 it inherits that card's `domain:ui` and priority.

Filed by the `domain:ui` seat #2 (`session_014mXUNuFomfj24w7s1pZzhN`) from objectui#10778's census (dev report `5857782762`) and the contract review of PR objectui#10809. The review corrected one row of the census, `record:line_items`. The seat read each site at source; nothing was run.

## The rows (the fourth batch of page-embeddable blocks without a bus reader)

The census covered every `PUBLIC_BLOCKS` entry plus the console-registered keys. After PR objectui#10809, two rows can be held on a stored page and still read on mount with no data-invalidation reader:

| block | why a stored page can hold it and it reads there | reader |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `report` / `spec-report` over a dataset (`packages/plugin-report/src/DatasetReportRenderer.tsx`) | `PageComponentSchema.type` admits any registered key. It calls `queryDataset` on mount, and its effect keys on the query signature only | none |
| `record:line_items` with an authored `parentId` / `recordId` (`packages/plugin-form/src/LineItemsPanel.tsx`) | it resolves `parentId = schema.parentId \|\| schema.recordId \|\| record?.recordId` and takes `dataSource` from `useSchemaContext`, so an authored parent reads `find(childObject)` with no record context | none |

The same `spec-report` also renders inside `DrillDownDrawer`'s `drillDown.report` arm (the metric and pivot drills). It stays stale there too.

## Why it matters now

Decision B `5830213285` on objectui#10519 ("readers first") lets `PageView` stop remounting only once every page block a stored page can hold re-reads in place. PR objectui#10777 removes the remount. So these two rows would keep pre-action data after a page action. That is the window decision B exists to close. objectui#10778 (PR objectui#10809) covers the third batch; this is the fourth.

Rows the census ruled out (review of PR objectui#10809):
- `record:activity`, `record:history` and `record:reference_rail` read only under a record context, and `PageView` provides none;
- the `dashboard` block's dataset-bound widgets issue no query on the page path at all (filed separately).

## Direction (the objectui#10623 / objectui#10778 shape, for triage to confirm)

- Each effect takes the `useDataInvalidation` nonce for the object it queries (`dataChangeMatches`). For a dataset report, that is the object the dataset answer names (the `ObjectChart` dataset arm's key). ⛔ No second channel, no remount.
- Pin each through the real `SchemaRenderer`: a read on mount, a second after `notifyDataChanged({ objectName: '*' })` and one after its own object, and none after an unrelated object. A static control gets no read.

Blocks: objectui#10519.
